date: "2026-02-11"

```{r cars}
library(survival)

url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vincentarelbundock/Rdatasets/master/csv/survival/pbc.csv"
df <- read.csv(url, row.names = 1)

df <- df[df$status != 1, ]
df <- df[!is.na(df$trt), ]

mean_age <- mean(df$age, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_bili <- mean(df$bili, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_albumin <- mean(df$albumin, na.rm = TRUE)

df$age <- df$age - mean_age
df$bili <- df$bili - mean_bili
df$albumin <- df$albumin - mean_albumin

df$trt <- as.factor(df$trt)
df$edema <- as.factor(df$edema)
df$stage <- as.factor(df$stage)

fit_po <- survreg(Surv(time, status) ~ trt + age + bili + albumin + edema + stage,
                  data = df, dist = "loglogistic")

newdata1 <- data.frame(
  trt = factor(2, levels = levels(df$trt)),
  age = 40 - mean_age,
  bili = 3 - mean_bili,
  albumin = 4 - mean_albumin,
  edema = factor(0.5, levels = levels(df$edema)),
  stage = factor(3, levels = levels(df$stage))
)

newdata2 <- data.frame(
  trt = factor(2, levels = levels(df$trt)),
  age = 40 - mean_age,
  bili = 3 - mean_bili,
  albumin = 4 - mean_albumin,
  edema = factor(1, levels = levels(df$edema)),
  stage = factor(3, levels = levels(df$stage))
)

times <- seq(1, 4000, length.out = 400)

pred1 <- predict(fit_po, newdata = newdata1, type = "quantile", p = seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01))
pred2 <- predict(fit_po, newdata = newdata2, type = "quantile", p = seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01))

survival_ph1 <- data.frame(time = pred1, value = seq(0.99, 0.01, by = -0.01))
survival_ph2 <- data.frame(time = pred2, value = seq(0.99, 0.01, by = -0.01))

hazard_ph1 <- data.frame(time = times, value = dlogis(log(times), location = predict(fit_po, newdata1, type = "lp"), scale = fit_po$scale) / times / (1 - plogis(log(times), location = predict(fit_po, newdata1, type = "lp"), scale = fit_po$scale)))
hazard_ph2 <- data.frame(time = times, value = dlogis(log(times), location = predict(fit_po, newdata2, type = "lp"), scale = fit_po$scale) / times / (1 - plogis(log(times), location = predict(fit_po, newdata2, type = "lp"), scale = fit_po$scale)))

cumhazard_ph1 <- data.frame(time = times, value = -log(1 - plogis(log(times), location = predict(fit_po, newdata1, type = "lp"), scale = fit_po$scale)))
cumhazard_ph2 <- data.frame(time = times, value = -log(1 - plogis(log(times), location = predict(fit_po, newdata2, type = "lp"), scale = fit_po$scale)))

baseline_survival <- data.frame(time = times, value = 1 - plogis(log(times), location = 0, scale = fit_po$scale))
baseline_hazard <- data.frame(time = times, value = dlogis(log(times), location = 0, scale = fit_po$scale) / times / (1 - plogis(log(times), location = 0, scale = fit_po$scale)))
baseline_cumhazard <- data.frame(time = times, value = -log(1 - plogis(log(times), location = 0, scale = fit_po$scale)))

write.csv(survival_ph1, "survival_ph1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(survival_ph2, "survival_ph2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(hazard_ph1, "hazard_ph1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(hazard_ph2, "hazard_ph2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cumhazard_ph1, "cumhazard_ph1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cumhazard_ph2, "cumhazard_ph2.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(baseline_survival, "baseline_survival.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(baseline_hazard, "baseline_hazard.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(baseline_cumhazard, "baseline_cumhazard.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
